tools.name: hs_tariff
tools.description: Find the HS/commodity code and import duty for goods shipped into the UK or the US. Looks up a code or keyword: UK Global Tariff third-country duty, preferential rates by origin where given, VAT and measure types from the UK Trade Tariff, and US HTS general, special and column-2 rates from USITC. findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "hs_tariff" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.
